sn45.19:1.1: pāṭaliputte: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn45.19:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ? katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti?
sn45.19:1.5: bhaddako kho te āvuso bhadda, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
sn45.19:1.6: evaṃ hi tvaṃ āvuso bhadda, pucchasi
sn45.19:1.8: katamaṃ nu kho āvuso brahmacariyaṃ, katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti?
sn45.19:1.10: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ. seyyathidaṃ:
sn45.19:1.12: yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo.
